video_title: Is this the BEST VERSION of Giannis amid Klay Thompson's resurgence? 🔥 | Get Up YouTube Exclusive

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers have significant work to reach elite Finals contender status
quotes.excerpt: they've got a lot of work to do to go from the team they have now to a Finals team
quotes.quote: I'm not going to discourage 76ers fans from feeling that way, but the guys in that locker room, Nick Nurse, everybody on that staff, understand they've got a lot of work to do to go from the team they have now to a Finals team. 12-3 is a phenomenal record, especially with all the new pieces coming together, but when you look under the hood, you look at things like point differential, this is not the best team in the Eastern Conference at this point. Can they get there? That's certainly within the realm of possibilities, but I would not consider them to be Finals favorites.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon on the 12-3 76ers: While the record is phenomenal, when you look under the hood at point differential, this is not the best team in the Eastern Conference right now and they are not Finals favorites.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers are an average offensive team compared to elite Eastern competitors
quotes.excerpt: the 76ers right now are an average offensive team. Boston Celtics are an elite offensive team
quotes.quote: Let's just be clear. The 76ers right now are an average offensive team. Boston Celtics are an elite offensive team. I can go down the list of teams in the East that are better offenses right now than the 76ers. The 76ers are a phenomenal, fancy basketball lineup that's figuring out how to play together. The Celtics, with our old friend Paul George, that thing is clicking right away. That's an elite offense.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon says the 76ers are currently just an average offensive team compared to elite Eastern Conference squads like the Celtics, who he notes are clicking right away.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey is the primary closer for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is the number one option. He's their primary closer
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is the number one option. He's their primary closer. And then it goes from there. Jaylen Brown is going to get some opportunities, Joel Embiid is going to get some opportunities, LeBron James is going to be involved, but Tyrese Maxey is clearly the closer on this team. I do think that it's healthy for them to have that clearly established pecking order this early in the process.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon on the 76ers pecking order: Tyrese Maxey is clearly the number one option and the primary closer for this team.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat turnaround driven by improved chemistry and defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: it was getting through what was an awful start and starting to develop some chemistry, some rapport
quotes.quote: I really just think it was getting through what was an awful start and starting to develop some chemistry, some rapport. Their defense was awful early on. It was a combination of poor effort and then bad luck. Some of the shooting against them was outlier type of performances. But you've seen Giannis and Bam. There are a lot of questions about is that going to be a clunky fit? You've seen them developing chemistry.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon credits the Heat turnaround to improved chemistry and defensive effort after an awful start to the season.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell is performing at a high level for the Heat
quotes.excerpt: he's averaging 16 plus points per game efficiently and leading the league in assists
quotes.quote: Davion Mitchell, I talked to a lot of people around the league and the consensus is he's not really a starting point guard. He's a high-caliber backup. Well, all the guy is doing is averaging 16 plus points per game efficiently and leading the league in assists. The Heat will certainly point to guys like Jaylen Brunson, not saying he's going to be the next Jaylen Brunson, but basically saying, look, some guys, it takes a little bit later in their career, maybe even a change of scenery, to see what they can really be. And he's performing at a high-level starter level right now.
quotes.social_post: Davion Mitchell is proving the doubters wrong. Tim MacMahon notes he is performing at a high-level starter level for the Heat, averaging over 16 points and leading the league in assists.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis remains a top-five player despite criticism
quotes.excerpt: he's still a top five player in the league
quotes.quote: This is a very good version of Giannis. I'm not going to sit here and tell you it's the best version of Giannis, a guy who had a 50 point, 15 rebound, five block Finals closeout game. The best version of Giannis is he's clearly the best player in the NBA. He's reminding us though, he's still a top five player in the league. Some of the criticism of Giannis is, hey, he can only play one way. That one way, when guys are willing to fit around him, is certainly proving to be effective.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon on Giannis: He is still a top five player in the league. While this might not be his absolute best version, he is proving to be effective when guys are willing to fit around him.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson's resurgence is one of the league's best bargains
quotes.excerpt: Klay is absolutely been cooking since then. He's feasting on three-point shots
quotes.quote: Early on when they were 0-4 and I'm talking to scouts who'd seen the Heat play, people were telling me, man, they're going to have to pull Klay from the starting lineup. Which hey, the Mavericks did that last year. Klay is absolutely been cooking since then. He's not anything close to the defender he used to be, but he's putting forth effort. He is feasting on three-point shots. Klay went to Dallas expected to get fed wide open, butt naked threes on a regular basis because he was playing with a perennial MVP candidate. Well, he's playing with an MVP candidate now. He's getting great looks and he's knocking them down on a regular basis. I mean, he during this stretch, he's shooting in the high 40s and at over 10 per game. This is absolutely one of the best bargains in the league when you consider that he's making less than $6 million dollars this year.
quotes.social_post: Klay Thompson is one of the best bargains in the NBA this season. Tim MacMahon notes he is feasting on wide open looks and shooting in the high 40s while making less than 6 million dollars.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's maturity and passing stand out for a teenager
quotes.excerpt: he comes in as a teenager and the NBA game is not too fast for him
quotes.quote: This guy comes in as a teenager and the NBA game is not too fast for him. It's not too advanced for him. He's processing things like a 10-year veteran. For a power forward, this guy is one of the best passers in the league right now, stepping into the league. And then obviously, he's a big physical guy. You see the touch that he has, but again, it's the fact that he step right in the league as a premier facilitator, rebounder and winner.
quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon on Cameron Boozer: This guy comes in as a teenager and the game is not too fast for him. He is processing things like a 10-year veteran and is already one of the best passers in the league.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer has a slight edge for Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: I think he's got a slight edge over Yaxl for Rookie of the Year
quotes.quote: I think that's a matter of taste and it was a matter of taste going into the draft. Yaxl wasn't considered a candidate to go number one. I still don't think he would in a redraft. Darren Peterson was, Caleb Wilson for some people was, but there were at least several teams who had Cameron Boozer as the number one player in the draft. The analytical machines had him as clearly the number one player in the draft. As you mentioned, the concern was the size and relative lack of athleticism. And he has struggled a little bit to finish. But again, there were a lot of teams that would have taken Cameron Boozer number one, including I believe the Memphis Grizzlies and they're certainly happy that he fell to number three. Early on, I think he's got a slight edge over Yaxl for Rookie of the Year.
quotes.social_post: Early Rookie of the Year race: Tim MacMahon believes Cameron Boozer has a slight edge over Yaxl for the award.
